translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús-sapingan Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidgi sunmakapid
Jesús na e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwad danar oambikusgu, amarga bela igar-uksad, Bab-Dummad-ganguedba dulemargi niamar-oniegar, degine, dulemar-uelemalad-nudakegarbar.
Geb degi Jesús na e-sapingan-barmisad, adi Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidgi sunmakegar, degi, dulemar-uelemalad nudakbaligar.
Na e-sapinganga Jesús sogsad: “Mer ibmar igarba sedmalo, suar-gaapoled suli, sagu suli, mas-gunned suli, degine, mani surbar. Deginbali, unnila mor-yoigwabi be namarbaloed.
Ar doa-negse be dogdapoe, a-negginbi be megoed, geb be naoedse. Mer neg-baid-baidgi gabdigumalo. Ar a-neggi-mai geb be baid-neggweburse naoed.

“Ar bia be-abingassurmalar, a-neggweburgi be nodmaloed, geb be-naggi-olli-nanaid nue eli-eli saoed, adi dulemar mag be-dakmalagar bemar Bab-Dummad-igargi ega sunmakapmarmoganad, degisoggu emargindo, ar Bab-Dummad-igar yapa abingamalad.”
Jesús-sapingan-ambe-gakabo-guedi bela neggweburmar-burwiganase Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi sunmakdii-guarmalad, degi, dulemar-gegumalad nudakdii-gusmarbalid.
Juan-Bautista burgwisad
Herodes dummadga-maid itoargu, Jesús bela-ibmar-imakdiid, geger nue-ito naded, ar ade abar sogmalad: “We-Jesús, Juan-Bautista-burgwisad gannar durgusye.”

Baigan sogmarbalid: “We-Jesús, epenne-Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged, Elías-nugad, gannar noniye.” Degine, baigandi sogmalad: “We-Jesús, epenne-Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged-wargwen-gudigusad gannar durgusye.”
Herodesdi sogded: “Juan-Bautista-ibe nono an siksadde, ¿degite, wede doa-sunna, dulemar-egi-sunmak an itoged?” Degisoggu, Herodes Jesús-dakbiguarsunnad.
Jesús miliatar-dulemar masgi oguchad

Jesús-sapingan-e-ambe-gakabo-gued, Jesús-nuggi-barmilesmalad, gannar Jesússe nonimargu, ega sognonimalad bela ibmar imaksamalad. Jesús amarbi bachikii, nega-dule-sulidganba sesad, neggwebur-Betsaida-nugad-dikarba.

Dulemar wisguargu, Jesús Betsaida-neggwebursik nadye, dulemar ase nade-gusmarmogad. Jesússe nonimargu, Jesús dulemar-abingasad. Geb degi amarga Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidgi sunmaksigisad, degine, dulemar-nudakleged-abemalad nudaksabalid.

Ar neg-sedogusgu, e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwad Jesússe nonimalad, ega sognonimalad: —Dulemar be barmid, adi igarba neggweburmar-bukwadse, degi, neg-gwagwen-gwagwen igarba-mamaidgi sunna obunnomaloed, degi, agi mas-gunned sunna amimarbaloed, ar wegindi anmar nega-dule-sulidgangi-bukmalad.

Jesús na e-sapingan-abin sogded: —Bemar ega mas-gunned ukmar. E-sapingan, abin-imakdemarmogad: —Anmar unnila madu-gwaatar, degi, ua-ukabo nikmalad. Ar anmar degiir we-dulemar-ichesulidga mas baknaer-gebed.
Ar ade macherganbi-miliatar mergued. Geb degi Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Danar-danar, e-dulabo-gakambe-dulabo-gakambe, be urbemar.
E-sapingan deyob imaksamalad, bela deyob dulemar-urbismalad.

Geb degi Jesús madu-gwaataled susgu, ua-ukabogwad susbargu, niba atakdegu, Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsad. A-sorba madu biske-biske imasgu, ega merguded. Geb e-sapinganga ukded, adi amar dulemarga ukmarmogagar.
Degine, bela-dulemar-gudidimalad nue-immeles mas guchamalad. Mas-guchad-sorba, Jesús-sapingan madu, degi, ua-obichad, garba-gwaambe-gakabo-mergu wesmalad.
Pedro Jesúsga sogsad, be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadye
Ibagwengi, Jesús Bab Dummadse bachik gorsigusgu, deun e-sapingan eba bukwa-gusmogad. Amarse Jesús egichialid: —¿Doaye dulemar annik sogmala?

E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Gwenna-gwenna Juan-Bautistaye benik sogmalad. Baigandi sogmalad, be Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged, Elías-nugadye. Agi baigan sogmarbalid, be Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged-wargwen-epenne-gudigusad, gannar durgusye.
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —¿Bemardina, doaye annik sogmarmosunna? Geb degi Pedro, Jesús-abin sogded: —Be Cristo, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-duled.
Geb degi Jesús na e-sapinganga sabsur sogded, melle dulemar-baiganga bipisaar sogoye ede Cristoye, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-sunnadye.
Jesús na e-burgoedgi sunmaksad

Degi Jesús sogdebar: —Ani Dule-Machi, nue-wileger-gebed. Judiomar-girmar-dummagan, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degine, escribamar, amar gwen an-abingaosurmalad, an-oburgwemaloed. Geb degine, ibapaagi gannar an durgubaloed.

Degine, Jesús bela-dulemarga sogded: “Ar dule-wargwen an-sapinga gubiele, na dukin san ieger-gebed, nakrus bane-bane semaiyob nanaer-gebed, bato burgwenadapidyob, geb a-dule anba dagodo, geb a an-sapinga guodo.
“Ar dule-wargwen anba-naid-ular burgwebisulir, e-san-burba ei yogguodo. Ar anba-naid-ular burgwenonikirdi, adi na-e-san-burba yogguosurdo.
¿Ar ibi-nuedga dule-wargwenga gusar be insae, a-dule napneg-naid bela egadga imaksar, geb edi na bergusar, ar e-san-burbadi yoggusar? Suli. Ibmar-nuedga ega gussuliled.

“Ar dule-gwensak an-nug-ular bingegusale, degi, an-gaya-burba-ular bingegusbalile, ani Dule-Machi, a-dulegi an bingegumogoed, an ganguedgi, degi, an-Bab-ganguedgi, degi, anger-swilidikmalad-abargi an danikoedgi.
“Ar napira an bemarga soged, gwenna-gwenna wegi-bemar-bukmalad burgosulid, amba dula gudii, Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid bese noni be dakedsemalad.”
Jesús e-san-dakleged gwagsad
Jesús, na e-burgoedgi sunmaksad iba-baabakgus-dibe, a-sorba, Pedro, Juan, degi, Santiago sesa-gusad, yar-birse nakwided, Bab Dummadse golegar.
Jesús Bab Dummadse gorsigusgu, e-wagar-dakleged gwagded, e-mor bela dagudik, dakar-dakar dakle naded.
Geb agi Jesús-sapingan-warbaagwad dakdemar dulemar-epenne-dula-gudigusmalad, Moisés, degi, Elías, amar-warbogwad Jesúsmala sunmakgwichi.
Amar, gwallu-meegwad-abargi gwichi, Jesús Jerusaléngi-burgoedgi, degi, we-napneggi-bangudoedgi sunmakgwismalad.
Pedro, degi, baigan-eba-gudidimalad, gabed egi nue-obin itomar-inigwele, nue ataksamargu, Jesús-gangued, e-yeer-dakleged daksamalad, degi, dulemar-warbo Jesúsba gwichid daksamarbalid.

Degi, amar-warbogwad Jesúsgi bangudsokarmargu, Pedro, Jesúsga sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, we nueddo, wegi anmar gudigu. Anmar wegi obunnoged-neg-gwapaa sobmalodo: Gwagwen bega, baid Moisésgar, geb baid Elíasgarmo. Ar ade Pedro itosulid, yogsaar gole-gole gwichid.
Ar weyob Pedro sunmakgwichi, mogir emar-birgi nagunonikid. Dobe itodmalad, mogir emargi dognonigu.
Degi mogir-imbaba gaya-burba gollar, sogded: “We An-Machi-sabedi gued, a be nue itomar.”
Degi-sunmaked bergusgu, Jesús-sapingan dakarmalad unnila Jesúsbi wargwen gwichi. A-ibagangi Jesús-sapingan dulemar-baiganga ibmar-daksamalad gwen sogsasurmalad, bela daska edukusmalad.
Jesús machigwa-niaburba-nikad-nudaksad
A-oibosadgine, Jesús na e-sapingan-warbaagwadmala yar-birgi-gudiidgi aidearmargu, dulemar-bukidar ese nonimalad.
Agi dule-wargwen, dulemar-bukidarad-abargi binnasur gote, sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, an-machi anga wis be dake, ar webi wargwen an wis nikad.
Dakargu, burba-iskana an-machigi nagunonikir, binnasur gote-daed, degine, binnasur wawanmakde-daed, gayaba maku-maku guar-daed, burba-iskana binnasur imak-daed, degine, bar indakbisur guar-daed.
Be-sapingangi an wilesanad, adi ega niaburba onogegar. Be-sapingan ega gwen nia-onossurmalad.

Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —¡Bemar Bab-Dummadgi-bengumalad-dulemar, bemar Bab-Dummad-igar-oakalogedmar! ¿Sanase bemar-abargi an gudiguosunna, bemar mer an-bengumalagar? ¿Sanase mag be itomaloe? Budar an bemar-daked-danikid. Be-machigwa anse be sedage.
Machigwa Jesússe danigu, niaburba machigwa-omukusad, degi, binnasur owawanmakded. Ar Jesúsdi niaburba-iskanase uluded, degi, machigwa-nudaksad. Geb degi e-babga machigwa-uksasunnad.
Jesús ilabogus gannar na e-burgoedgi sunmaksad
Jesús niaburba-iskana onosadba, bela dulemar Bab-Dummad-gangued geger dakedbimalad. Bela-dulemar Jesús-ibmar-imakdiid, geger dakbukmala, Jesús e-sapinganga sogded:
—Ar nue be itomar we an-ibmar-sogoed, mer ieged be imakmalo, ar ade ani Dule-Machi, dulemarse uklegoed, an-oburgwemalagar.
Weyob Jesús ega ibmar sogsad e-sapingan aku-itosmalad, ar ade emargi odukulegar gusad, adi aku-itomalagar. E-sapingan dobedba Jesússe gwen egichissurmalad, we ibi ega nue obarisa.
¿Doa bur-dule-dummadi?
Geb degi Jesús-e-sapingan na muchub-muchub abin-abin imakarmalad, doa-bur-dummadga guoye.
Ar Jesús, e-sapingan-gwage-binsanaid mag daksagu, machi-bipi-wargwen-susad. E-walik ogwichisgu,

e-sapinganga sogded: —Ar doa-dule an-nuggine we machi-bipi ber nue-weligwar abingaele, an-abinganaiyob gunaid. Aginbali, ar doa-dule an-abingaele, dule-an-barmialid abinganaido. Ar ade na bemar doa-bur-bipigwadi, a bur-dule-dummadid.
Jesús sogsad, anmargi-yoledisurmalad, anmar-balidye
Juan, Jesús-abin imakdegu, sogded: —Odurdaked-saila, anmar dule-wargwen-daksado be-nuggi niamar-onodii. A-dule anmar-sordasursoggu, anmar ega sogsado, mer Jesús-nuggi bar niamar-onogoye.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Mer a-dule-ibe igar-bisko. Ar dule anmargi yoledisulile, a-dule, we anmar-sordado.
Jesús, Santiagoga, degi, Juanga sabsur ibmar sogsad
Jesús nibnegse-naed-e-ibagan warmaknonigu, Jesús, Jerusalénse nue naed sokarsunnad.
Jesús igarba nadapgu, e-iduale na dulemar-barmisad. Amar nadgu, Samaria-neggwebur-bipigwadse dogdapmalad, adi agi idu guagwar neg-amimalagar.
Ar Samaria-neggwebur-bipigwadginmalad Jesús-gwen-abingassurmalad, ar ade daksamalad Jesús Jerusalénse naesokalid.
E-sapingan, Santiago, degi, Juan, deyob daksamargu, Jesúsga sogdemalad: —Dummad, ¿anmar nibneggi-soo-odedabi be abege, igi epenne Elías imaksamoga, adi wemar bela-ogumakegar?
Geb degi Jesús amar-warbogwadsik atakdegu, amarga sabsur ibmar sogded: —Ar bemar na be wichurmardo igi-daed-burba be nikmala.
Ar ani Dule-Machi, nonigua, dulemar-san-burba-oyogguegala an nonisulid, an nonikid, dulemar-san-burba-abonogegar. Geb degi Jesús na e-sapinganmala neggwebur-baidse nadmarsunnad.
Jesúsba nabigusmalanad
Jesús na e-sapinganmala nadgua, dule-wargwen igarba ega sokalid: —Dummad, ar bia be naoe, an beba naiguoed.
Jesús a-dulega sogded: —Ar usmardi na e-gubya nikmalad, sikwimar-niba-gukudimaladdi na e-uu nikmarbalid, ar andi Dule-Machi, andi na neg sated. Anyob be unni nanamogale, anba be dagodo.
Jesús dule-baidga sogded: —Anba be dage, an-sapinga guegar. Dule abin-sogded: —Dummad, bina an-babse an nagwelo, an-bab-burgwedse geb beba an naoed.
Jesús ega sogded: —Ar dulemar-burbar-bato-burgwar-gudimalad, we-napneggi na e-burgwarmalad-digoed, ar bedi, nae, Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaidgi dulemarga be sunmaknae.
Geb degi dule-baid Jesúsga sogdemogad: —Dummad, an beba naoed, ar bina an-neg-yaginmaladga degimaloye an sognagwelo.

Jesús aga sogded: —Ar dule neg-imunaidgi akas-dibe gwen yarganba baratakdisulid. Ar dule yarganba atakele, we-dule Bab-Dummad-neg-dakmaid geg egadga gued. Deyobmodo, dule binsaed-darbo-damalad, Bab-Jesúsba nagubibali, degi, we-napnegginedba ibmar imakbibardo.
